text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I need to make up my mind soon. Enter... 
Don't enter... Enter... Don't enter...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: —Alright, I'm heading out!
(UWAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first leg of the Classic Triple Crown: 
the Satsuki Sho. Mejiro Palmer mustered 
her courage and chose to enter the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Palmer, good luck today. I'm happy to be 
running with you!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Yeah, me too! Let's give it our all today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It's true that I'm happy. But that's not 
all. It's a little... no, that's a lie.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(It's a little scary... To think that 
Ryan... the girl I could never beat as a 
kid, is my rival today.)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"‘Satsuki Sho’... Honestly, my legs are 
shaking... But when Palmer is around, 
somehow it's like—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: That's a bit of a relief, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Rel...ief?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah. You know, Palmer... even when we 
were kids, whenever trouble came up, you'd 
almost always find a way to fix it, 
right?"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's why just having you by my side puts 
me at ease. Even on a massive stage like 
this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Right... I see.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAAAAAH!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, it's really frustrating after 
all, huh~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
I'm conscious of them, but they don't even 
notice me... But still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Part of me is actually a little happy that 
Ryan told me she "feels at ease having me 
around."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Haaah-ah, I guess you could say I hate 
this part of myself. Still, I don't wanna 
stay like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Position... Yeah, I'm still just the 
mediator for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"No, this is wrong. This isn't who I want 
to be! That's why...!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I'll try running away. From who I 
was that day. As far as I can possibly go 
right now, wherever that takes me!
